items.originalTitle: Why Kimi Antonelli was left fighting his Mercedes brakes during the Singapore GP
detailZh: 为什么基米·安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中与梅赛德斯刹车作斗争
梅赛德斯车手在跟车过程中遇到了刹车力不足的问题
基米·安东内利带着另一个领奖台的成绩和比队友乔治·拉塞尔高出102分的领先优势离开了滨海湾街道赛道。他确实掌控着车手锦标赛，因为他又完成了一场精彩的比赛。但他在将梅赛德斯赛车撞上护栏后差点离开赛道，因为刹车踏板开始出现异常。
在红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘和法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔之后获得第三名的成绩背后隐藏着一场令人惊讶的紧张驾驶。
安东内利的比赛在灯光还未熄灭时就已经出现了问题，因为车队在赛车停在赛道上时发现了刹车传感器故障。修复工作立即进行，但车队不得不在没有刹车数据的情况下驾驶他的赛车。
在比赛中，这位年轻的意大利人抱怨说没有足够的刹车力。在新加坡赛事之后的新闻发布会上，他回答了关于他是如何处理这个问题的提问。
“嗯，我只是尽量在每次刹车前抬起并滑行，以便到达得慢一些，并减少对油门的压力，”他说。‘特别是在VSC重启时，当我刹车时，什么也没发生。我的刹车性能真的很差，刹车力不足，我差点撞上墙。’
“所以，那里真的很棘手，而且油门也很长。但这也是可以预料的。你知道，我已经在充满污浊空气的赛车后面跑了三分之二的比赛，显然非常热。”
“此外，我们还遇到了刹车传感器的故障，所以我们甚至没有刹车数据的记录。我们不知道它们的温度是多少，所以一切都只能凭感觉。但是它们很热，因为我甚至能闻到，所以并不愉快。”
新的套件仍然有很窄的操作窗口
车手冠军也被问及了他在马来西亚赛车未能达到预期后，第二次在梅赛德斯上使用的升级套件。
““我认为在这个赛道上，还不是，”安东内利承认。“在这个有很多低速的赛道上，性能还没有达到最佳。这仅仅是因为有了旧的套件，你知道该把车放在哪里，哪个窗口，车会运行得非常好。”"
“有了这个新套件，我们看到了它的潜力，它能带来的性能，我在某些角落确实感受到了。但汽车目前运行的空间窗口太小了。所以在驾驶上，它对你在接近弯道或攻击刹车的方式上所做的任何不同都非常敏感。”
“所以，我觉得，是的，这个套件将会更快，我认为一旦我们了解了如何发挥其全部潜力，它将是一个很好的进步。”
Austin 将会是 Brackley 车队的下一个机会。”
detailEn: Why Kimi Antonelli was left fighting his Mercedes brakes during the Singapore GP
The Mercedes driver struggled with poor stopping power behind traffic

Kimi Antonelli left the Marina Bay Circuit with another podium finish and a 102-point lead over team-mate George Russell. He is indeed in control of the drivers' championship with another great race under his belt. But he almost left the track after putting his Mercedes into a barrier because the brake pedal started misbehaving.
The third-place finish behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc hid a surprisingly fraught drive.

Antonelli's race started with an issue before the lights even turned off as the team found a brake sensor fault while the car was sat on the grid. The fix was carried out there and then, but the team had to run his car without any brake data.

More issues came during the race when the young Italian complained of having no stopping power. During the press conference following his Singapore campaign, he answered questions of how he drove around the issue.

"Well, just trying to lift and coast before every braking and to arrive a bit slower and put less pressure on the pedal," he said. "Because especially on the restart of the VSC, when I went to brake, nothing happened. I had really poor stopping, brake power and I almost went into the wall.

"So, it was just very tricky out there, and also the pedal was very long. But it was also kind of expected. You know, I've run three-quarters of the race behind a car in dirty air and obviously being so hot.

"Plus, we also had the sensor issue on the brakes, so we didn't even have the data about the brakes. We didn't know exactly what temperature they were running, so it was all about feeling. But they were hot because I could even smell it, so it was not very pleasant."
The new package still has a narrow operating window
The title leader was also asked about the upgrade package he ran on the Mercedes for the second time after the car failed to deliver in Malaysia.

"I think on this track, not yet," Antonelli admitted. "On this track, where you have a lot of slow speed, still not quite there in terms of performance. It's just because with the old package, you know exactly where to put the car, which window, and the car works very nicely.

"With this new package, we see the potential, the performance that it can bring, and I do feel it in certain corners. But the window is just too small of where the car operates at this moment. So also in driving, it's very sensitive to any differences that you do in the way you approach a corner or how you attack braking.
"So, I feel like, yes, the package is going to be faster and it's going to be, yeah, I think it can be a good step forward once we understand how to use the full potential."
Austin will be the Brackley outfit's next opportunity.

items.summaryZh: 皮亚斯特里认为他在新加坡大奖赛的爆胎实际上帮助他在周日的一级方程式比赛中超越了汉密尔顿，获得第五名。

items.originalTitle: Oscar Piastri on his Singapore puncture: “Ironically, it probably helped”
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂关于他在新加坡的轮胎扎孔：“讽刺的是，这可能反而帮了我”
皮亚斯蒂在没有轮胎扎孔的情况下能打败汉密尔顿获得前五名吗？澳大利亚人并不确定
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂认为他在新加坡大奖赛的轮胎扎孔实际上帮助他在周日的F1比赛中超越了刘易斯·汉密尔顿，获得了第五名
当虚拟安全车在第39圈被叫入行动时，皮亚斯蒂孤独地排在第六位，落后第三名的汉密尔顿20秒，落后队友兰多·诺里斯7秒，此时兰斯·斯特罗尔因离合器问题被拉到一边。
尽管比任何领跑者都使用了更旧的轮胎，汉密尔顿还是决定继续使用磨损的软胎。皮亚斯蒂也是如此，他的中等轮胎比汉密尔顿年轻15圈，但一个慢漏气实际上迫使这位麦凯轮车手在第41圈进行了第二次进站。
皮亚斯蒂在软胎上重新加入比赛，落后汉密尔顿37秒，但每圈快两秒，并在倒数第三圈缩小了差距。法拉利赛车手坚定地捍卫了他的位置，但在那个44圈的比赛中，使用红色墙状复合材料的轮胎结束时无能为力。
“这绝对是我们能做的最好了，我们没有速度去做更多。显然，这里是一场巨大的位置争夺战，”皮亚斯蒂指出。
“我觉得我个人做得相当不错。显然，漏气有点遗憾，但讽刺的是，它实际上可能帮了我。我在最后追上了刘易斯，所以每件事都有一线希望。”
在完成超越之后，澳大利亚车手补充道：“这很艰难，因为一旦到达那里，轮胎很容易过热，你似乎就会陷入他们的节奏中。
“但考虑到我追得有多快，如果我没有超越，我会对自己感到失望。所以，有一点点兴奋，这是好事，因为否则这将是一场相当孤独的比赛。”
麦凯轮车队负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉说，慢漏气的具体原因尚未阐明，车队将与轮胎供应商倍耐力进行调查。
“这确实是一件相当不寻常的事情，”斯特拉评论道。 “比如，这是我今年第一次听说慢漏气。今天对奥斯卡来说损失不大，但在一场更接近的比赛中，这可能会造成显著的时间损失，所以这绝对是我们需要解决的问题。我不认为这是一个与车队相关的问题。但理想情况下，任何竞争对手都不应该遇到这种情况。”
皮亚斯特里的“相当孤独的比赛”标志着他连续13场大奖赛没有登上领奖台——这是他自2023年新秀赛季以来的最差纪录。
这位2025年冠军争夺者在他之前的57场比赛中取得了28次前三名成绩。
detailEn: Oscar Piastri on his Singapore puncture: “Ironically, it probably helped”
Would Piastri have beaten Hamilton to a top-five finish without his puncture? The Australian is not so sure
Oscar Piastri believes his Singapore Grand Prix puncture actually helped him overtake Lewis Hamilton for fifth place in Sunday’s Formula 1 race.

Piastri lay a lonely sixth – 20 seconds down on third-placed Hamilton and seven seconds adrift of team-mate Lando Norris – when the virtual safety car was called into action on lap 39 at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, as Lance Stroll pulled aside due to a clutch issue.

Despite having the oldest tyres of any frontrunner by some margin, Hamilton decided to stay out on worn soft rubber. So did Piastri, whose medium tyres were 15 laps younger, but a slow puncture actually forced the McLaren driver into a second stop on lap 41.

Piastri rejoined on soft rubber, with a 37-second deficit to Hamilton, but was two seconds a lap quicker and bridged that gap by the antepenultimate lap. The Ferrari racer staunchly defended his position but was powerless at the end of that 44-lap stint with the red-walled compound.
“That was definitely the most we could have done, we didn't have the pace to do any more. Obviously, here is a massive track-position race,” Piastri pointed out.

“I feel like personally, I did a pretty good job. Obviously, the puncture was a bit of a shame, but ironically, it actually probably helped. I got Lewis at the end, so there is a silver lining to everything.”
Following up on his overtake, the Australian added: “It was tough, because also, once you get there, it doesn't take much to overheat the tyres and you kind of get stuck at their pace.
“But with how quickly I was catching, I would have been pretty disappointed in myself if I didn't get past. So, a bit of excitement, which was good, because otherwise it was a pretty lonely race.”
McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said the reason for the slow puncture was yet to be elucidated and the squad would look into it with tyre supplier Pirelli.

“It's honestly a pretty unusual event,” Stella commented. “Like, it's the first time that I hear about a slow puncture this year. It didn't cost very much to Oscar today, but in a closer race, it could have been a significant loss of time, so definitely something that we need to get on top of. I don't think that this is a team-dependent kind of issue. But ideally, it doesn't happen for any competitor.”
Piastri’s “pretty lonely race” marked his 13th consecutive grand prix without a podium finish – his worst streak since the beginning of his rookie season in 2023.
The 2025 title contender had collected 28 top-three results across his previous 57 starts.

detailZh: 如何免费观看马克斯·维斯塔潘参加GT世界挑战赛波尔图的比赛：直播、开始时间和日程
红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘将与本·巴尼科特和克里斯·卢尔汉共同驾驶Team 维斯塔潘 Racing的梅赛德斯-AMG GT3赛车
#3 梅赛德斯-AMG Team 维斯塔潘 Racing，梅赛德斯AMG GT3 EVO：马克斯·维斯塔潘
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
在新加坡成功的一周后，马克斯·维斯塔潘现在正享受着在一级方程式赛车之外难得的一周，他正在驾驶梅赛德斯-AMG GT3赛车。显然，一级方程式的赛程对这位荷兰人来说还不够具有挑战性，他将参加在葡萄牙波尔图举行的2026赛季GT世界挑战赛决赛轮。这就是你可以在哪里观看这场比赛的方式和地点。
这位红牛车手不仅将在滨海湾街道赛道上赢得一场胜利，还将为迁址的巴林大奖赛在马来西亚赢得一场胜利。也许这种势头会跟随他来到阿尔加维。
“这将是一段忙碌的七周，但我将享受它，”当参赛资格首次公布时他说道。
三小时的赛事将于10月17日星期六当地时间下午5点开始，并于晚上8点结束。
本·巴尼科特和克里斯·卢尔汉将加入维斯塔潘，加入#3车队维斯塔潘赛车。丹尼尔·琼卡德拉和朱尔斯·贡农，通常驾驶这辆车的车手，将在同周末参加FIA世界耐力锦标赛，这意味着车队的天才预备车手将不得不顶替上场。
这将是他自今年早些时候纽博格林24小时耐力赛以来的首次GT赛事回归。那场比赛以糟糕的方式结束，他的赛车因技术故障而退赛，但他希望他能在本周末夺回属于他的胜利。这场比赛将更短，也许给他提供更好的成功机会。
然而，波尔蒂马奥是一个更紧凑的赛道，所以其沥青上的61辆车可能会造成一些交通问题，并且不会缺少动作。

detailEn: How to watch Max Verstappen race GT World Challenge Portimao free: Live stream, start time and schedule
The Red Bull driver will share Team Verstappen Racing’s Mercedes-AMG GT3 with Ben Barnicoat and Chris Lulham
#3 Mercedes-AMG Team Verstappen Racing, Mercedes AMG GT3 EVO: Max Verstappen
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

After a successful weekend in Singapore, Max Verstappen is now spending a rare week outside of Formula 1 behind the wheel of a Mercedes-AMG GT3. Apparently, the F1 schedule isn't punishing enough for the Dutchman, who will be racing Portimao, Portugal, in the season-concluding 2026 GT World Challenge round. This is how and where you can watch it.
The Red Bull driver will be coming off not just a win at the Marina Bay Circuit, but also a win in Malaysia for the relocated Bahrain Grand Prix. Maybe this momentum could follow him to the Algarve.
"It is going to be a busy seven weeks, but I will enjoy it," he said when the entry was first announced.
The three-hour race will begin on Saturday, 17 October, at 5pm local time. It will come to an end at 8pm.

Ben Barnicoat and Chris Lulham will join Verstappen in the #3 Team Verstappen Racing entry. Daniel Juncadella and Jules Gounon, who would usually be driving the car, will be driving in the FIA World Endurance Championship that same weekend, meaning the team's talented reserve driver will have to step in.

This will be his first return to GT competition since the Nurburgring 24 Hours earlier this year. That race ended badly, with his car falling out of the race due to a technical failure, but he's hoping he can take back what's his this coming weekend. This race will be shorter, offering him maybe a better chance at success.
Portimao, however, is a more compact circuit, so the 61 cars on its asphalt may create a few traffic issues and no shortage of action.
24h Spa 2026: Verstappen-AMG raus, erneuter Ferrari-Reifenschaden
Qualifying takes place on Friday from 5.55pm to 7.05pm local time. Race day follows on Saturday, with the green flag at 5pm and the chequered flag waving at 8pm.
The GT World Challenge is streamed on the GT World YouTube channel and can be watched for free in multiple languages. Live coverage will begin on Friday with FP1 at 08:45.
